module_summary: AXI4 safety bridge between an upstream master and a possibly faulty downstream slave: each channel is double-buffered and forwarded while timers, burst counters and protocol checks detect bad slave responses, after which the faulted side is disconnected and answered with SLVERR.

anchors.name: o_write_fault
anchors.why: Write fault latch: disconnects slave write channels, forces SLVERR responses.

anchors.name: o_read_fault
anchors.why: Read fault latch: blocks AR forwarding, returns SLVERR reads.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Upstream write address valid; captured into AW double buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: Upstream AW ready; one write burst outstanding at a time.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Upstream write address, buffered then forwarded downstream.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Upstream write data forwarded through W double buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WREADY
anchors.why: Upstream W ready, opened after AW accepted, closed on WLAST.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Upstream write response valid from slave or locally generated error.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BRESP
anchors.why: Write response: slave BRESP or SLAVE_ERROR on fault.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Upstream read address valid; captured and starts read beat counter.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: Upstream AR ready; reopens after last read beat.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Upstream read address, buffered then forwarded downstream.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Upstream read data registered from slave or R double buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Upstream read data valid from m_rvalid selection.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RRESP
anchors.why: Read response: slave RRESP or SLAVE_ERROR on fault.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Downstream AW valid, suppressed on write fault.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: Downstream AW ready; loads write beat counter.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Downstream write address from m_awaddr.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Downstream W valid; null strobes on fault to drain burst.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WREADY
anchors.why: Downstream W ready; decrements pending write beats.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Downstream write data from m_wdata.

anchors.name: M_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Downstream write response, checked for protocol faults.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Downstream AR valid, suppressed on read fault.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: Downstream AR ready clearing AR buffer.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Downstream read address from m_araddr.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Downstream read data valid, checked for protocol faults.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Downstream read data into R buffer or upstream.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RREADY
anchors.why: Downstream R ready, low while R double buffer full.

anchors.name: write_timer
anchors.why: Write channel stall timer; saturating count triggers write timeout.

anchors.name: write_timeout
anchors.why: Write timeout flag setting o_write_fault.

anchors.name: read_timer
anchors.why: Read response wait timer; reaching OPT_TIMEOUT sets read timeout.

anchors.name: read_timeout
anchors.why: Read timeout flag setting o_read_fault.

anchors.name: faulty_write_return
anchors.why: Same-cycle check of illegal B response or W-before-AW.

anchors.name: faulty_read_return
anchors.why: Same-cycle check of illegal R response: wrong ID, early/late RLAST.

anchors.name: rfifo_counter
anchors.why: Outstanding read beats from ARLEN, decremented per upstream beat.

anchors.name: rfifo_empty
anchors.why: No read beats outstanding; resets read timer, gates error returns.

anchors.name: rfifo_last
anchors.why: Final read beat expected; checks RLAST and generates m_rlast.

anchors.name: m_wpending
anchors.why: Remaining downstream write beats from AWLEN.

anchors.name: m_wempty
anchors.why: No downstream write beats pending; detects early B response.

anchors.name: s_wbursts
anchors.why: Upstream write bursts awaiting response; detects extra B responses.

anchors.name: r_awvalid
anchors.why: AW double buffer occupied; selects buffered AW fields.

anchors.name: r_awaddr
anchors.why: Buffered write address held for downstream forwarding.

anchors.name: r_arvalid
anchors.why: AR double buffer occupied; selects buffered AR fields.

anchors.name: r_araddr
anchors.why: Buffered read address held for downstream forwarding.

anchors.name: r_wvalid
anchors.why: W skid buffer occupied when downstream W stalls.

anchors.name: r_wdata
anchors.why: W skid buffer data.

anchors.name: r_rvalid
anchors.why: R skid buffer occupied; drops M_AXI_RREADY.

anchors.name: r_rdata
anchors.why: R skid buffer data.

anchors.name: m_rvalid
anchors.why: Upstream read valid source: error generator, buffer or slave.

anchors.name: m_rresp
anchors.why: Read response mux: SLAVE_ERROR on fault, buffered or slave RRESP.

anchors.name: m_bvalid
anchors.why: Upstream B valid source: local error or slave BVALID.

anchors.name: waddr_valid
anchors.why: Write burst in progress; enables write timer and WREADY.

anchors.name: raddr_valid
anchors.why: Read burst in progress; unrequested read data is a fault.

groups.name: Write fault detector
groups.description: Timer, beat/burst counters and response checks latching o_write_fault.

groups.name: Read fault detector
groups.description: Timer, outstanding-beat counter and response checks latching o_read_fault.

groups.name: Write address/data path
groups.description: AW and W double buffers forwarding upstream write requests downstream.

groups.name: Write response path
groups.description: Passes slave B response or substitutes SLAVE_ERROR on fault.

groups.name: Read address path
groups.description: AR double buffer forwarding upstream read requests downstream.

groups.name: Read data path
groups.description: R skid buffer and response mux returning slave data or errors upstream.
